entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is 775-B-1138.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the order here for the Apex Pro jersey. Can I ask what the issue is?
It's the wrong size. It's way too tight in the shoulders. I just need to exchange it for the next size up.

I understand. Let me just confirm the delivery date... It looks like it was delivered 26 days ago. That's no problem at all. A jersey falls under our 90-day return policy, so you're well within the window.
Great. So you can process the exchange?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Just send the original jersey back, and we'll get the new one out. And since I see you're a VIP member, I've gone ahead and upgraded the shipping on the replacement to be complimentary next-day air.
Oh, perfect. That's very helpful. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a great day.
